raw: No one would offer the Infected any help. We were no volunteer army. We had nothing like the 'Brave Wok' from the age of Mikhail the Huge Ears. We had no city of our own, and we hardly even had fields to hill up.

raw: 'The Originium grows on our skin, and the scant few weapons we hold are stark. The snow in our mouths melts into our water, our stomachs are filled with grass seed and bark. '
content: 'The Originium grows on our skin, and the scant few weapons we hold are stark. The snow in our mouths melts into our water, our stomachs are filled with grass seed and bark. '

raw: And so they sang. I learned a good few of those in short order.
content: And so they sang. I learned a good few of those in short order.

raw: We were just some Infected with nowhere to go.
content: We were just some Infected with nowhere to go.

raw: I became more and more sure. Coming to the Northern Tundra first was the right choice. Nothing but people with nowhere to return, and nowhere to go, wherever you went.
content: I became more and more sure. Coming to the Northern Tundra first was the right choice. Nothing but people with nowhere to return, and nowhere to go, wherever you went.

raw: The Infected in the cities, singled out by the common folk. The races of each country looking on one another with suspicion of their differences. Only out on the tundra do people become a little simpler.
content: The Infected in the cities, singled out by the common folk. The races of each country looking on one another with suspicion of their differences. Only out on the tundra do people become a little simpler.

raw: I wanted to go back south. But this time, I probably wouldn't be going alone.
content: I wanted to go back south. But this time, I probably wouldn't be going alone.

raw: Infected dying of frostbite and hunger on the tundra is not the same as Infected dying of their illness on their own land.
content: Infected dying of frostbite and hunger on the tundra is not the same as Infected dying of their illness on their own land.

raw: The Infected should pioneer their own city. If Ursus doesn't allow it, then Ursus should be changed.
content: The Infected should pioneer their own city. If Ursus doesn't allow it, then Ursus should be changed.

raw: Exile, abdication, leaving the country—in the end, you were still a homeless vagabond. Whenever you told of a place that'd admit the Infected, you were telling a fairytale.
content: Exile, abdication, leaving the country—in the end, you were still a homeless vagabond. Whenever you told of a place that'd admit the Infected, you were telling a fairytale.

raw: If the Infected wanted to regain their dignity, they needed strength, unity, and a change in the status quo.
content: If the Infected wanted to regain their dignity, they needed strength, unity, and a change in the status quo.

raw: If we could gain the backing of the Infected guerrillas, then maybe this quest of ours would have some chance of success.
content: If we could gain the backing of the Infected guerrillas, then maybe this quest of ours would have some chance of success.

raw: It was important for the Infected to regain their confidence. It was crucial for us to have any sense of meaning in our lives.
content: It was important for the Infected to regain their confidence. It was crucial for us to have any sense of meaning in our lives.
